fields.subject: Selamat Hari Raya Aidilfitri: Campus Holiday Notice
fields.content:
Dear Staff and Students,

In celebration of the upcoming Hari Raya Aidilfitri, please be informed that the campus will be closed for the festive break.

  1. Holiday Start: Friday, 20th March 2026
  2. Campus Reopens: Wednesday, 25th March 2026

All classes and administrative operations will be suspended during this period. We encourage everyone to take this time to rest, celebrate with loved ones, and stay safe.

To those traveling back to their hometowns, we wish you a safe journey (Balik Kampung). To all our Muslim friends and colleagues, Selamat Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Maaf Zahir dan Batin.


Warm regards,

Campus Administration
